description: List the projects visible to this token (a project-scoped token sees only its project). A project with a 'parent' is a subproject of that one: it has its own issues, board and wiki, and shares only who may reach it. Archived projects — finished work put away, read-only — are left out unless includeArchived is true; 'archivedLeftOut' then counts them.

includeArchived.description: true to list archived projects too, each marked 'archived: true'.

name: list_projects
title: List projects
